notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.

description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
